description: This bar chart, titled “Accuracy (%)” on the left y-axis and “Token Count” on the right y-axis, visually compares the average performance and token usage of four models—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across four benchmarks, as referenced in the caption “Efficient Reasoning via Chain of Unconscious Thought.” The horizontal axis displays the model names, with each model represented by a distinct color: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The chart features two vertical axes: the left axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 70 to 100 in linear increments of 5, and the right axis, labeled “Token Count”, ranges from 0 to 800 in linear increments of 100. Each bar is topped with its corresponding value: CoT has an accuracy of 91.19% and a token count of 676.85; CoD has an accuracy of 80.89% and a token count of 534.24; CCoT has an accuracy of 88.50% and a token count of 445.91; and CoUT has an accuracy of 88.40% and a token count of 354.46. The bars are arranged in a single group per model, with each model’s accuracy bar on the left and its token count bar on the right, visually aligned by color. The bars are not sorted by value and are presented in the order of CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT from left to right. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any bars.
